editorial:
Imagine moving into your dream home in LA, only to find out the person who lived there before you died in a really gross way. That is exactly what happens to Arne, a guy who just wanted a fresh start. Things get weird when the dead woman's best friend shows up at his door. She is totally sure that her friend Tilly didn't kill herself and that someone actually murdered her. You get to watch these two unlikely partners team up to poke around the neighborhood and find clues. The whole vibe is a mix of a mystery and a goofy comedy that doesn't take itself too seriously.

You will love how the chemistry between the leads keeps the story moving, even when the clues get confusing. The pacing is snappy, though some of the jokes might feel a bit dated since it came out in 1999. If you like stories where regular people try to play detective, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After digging through the house, Arne and the friend find evidence that Tilly was actually poisoned by a family member for money. In the final scene, they catch the killer in a clumsy trap. The big twist is that the killer tried to frame Tilly for her own death using fake notes. Once the police arrive and take the killer away, Arne finally gets some peace in his home and starts a real friendship with Tilly's best friend.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky mysteries and lighthearted comedies.
